GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-10-18T13:19:20Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Checkpoint is saving the model based on the last val_metric_step value and not val_metric_epoch
Description: ## 🐛 Bug

Checkpoint callback did not save some models even thought they achieved better result in the monitored metric, than the currently top k saved models

### Expected behavior

Checkpoint callback saving the best scoring models based on a metric

### Environment

I am using pytorch-lightning 1.0.2

#### Update:
I changed the checkpoint call back to add the value I am monitoring to the name of the saved checkpoint, what I notice it's not the epoch value, but the last step in the epoch value, so it's not taking the metric average value, but taking only the last one.

llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a bug in the PyTorch Lightning checkpoint callback where it's saving models based on the last validation step metric rather than the epoch average. This is a logical/behavioral issue in the framework's code that doesn't require building or running code to verify. The problem can be understood through code analysis - the checkpoint callback is incorrectly using the step-level metric value instead of the epoch-level metric. A solution would involve examining the checkpoint callback implementation to ensure it's using the correct metric value (epoch average vs last step). This can be verified by reviewing the PyTorch Lightning source code without needing to set up a build environment or run any code.
